title: Rectangles to vertices
description:
Turn rectangles into the vertices and indices a draw list holds.

```
3 rectangles -> 12 vertices, 18 indices
rect 0: vertices 0-3, indices 0 1 2 0 2 3
2 draw commands (texture changed after rect 1)
```
hints: For a rectangle whose first vertex is number `base`, the indices are `base, base + 1, base + 2, base, base + 2, base + 3` (lesson 1.03).
Start a new `DrawCmd` when the list is empty or the texture differs from the last command's.
requirements: Each rectangle adds 4 vertices (position, colour) and 6 indices (two triangles).
Consecutive rectangles with the same texture share one draw command; a new texture starts a new one.
Print the totals and the first rectangle's data.
stretch: Add clip rectangles: a change of clip rectangle also starts a new command.
